ontology.name: FIBO Loans Lab — Step 4
ontology.description: Risk and classification entities for underwriting and collateral hierarchy modeling. Adapted from EDM Council FIBO. Source: https://github.com/edmcouncil/fibo — MIT License.

entityTypes.name: Loan
entityTypes.description: Debt instrument extended to a borrower and repaid according to contract terms.

entityTypes.name: Borrower
entityTypes.description: Party that receives funds and assumes repayment obligations.

entityTypes.name: Lender
entityTypes.description: Party that provides funds or credit under loan agreement terms.

entityTypes.name: Collateral
entityTypes.description: Asset pledged to secure repayment obligations.

entityTypes.name: LoanPaymentSchedule
entityTypes.description: Regular schedule defining due dates and expected loan payments.

entityTypes.name: Servicer
entityTypes.description: Financial service provider responsible for collecting loan payments.

entityTypes.name: PaymentHistory
entityTypes.description: Record of all payment events associated with a loan account.

entityTypes.name: PaymentTransaction
entityTypes.description: Single payment event that contributes to payment history.

entityTypes.name: OwnershipInterest
entityTypes.description: Classifier describing ownership nature for collateralized assets. Adapted from fibo-fnd-oac-own:OwnershipInterest.

entityTypes.name: LenderLienPosition
entityTypes.description: Classifier indicating lender claim seniority for collateral assets. Adapted from fibo-fbc-dae-dbt:LenderLienPosition.

relationships.name: owedBy
relationships.description: Relates a loan to the borrower obligated to repay it.

relationships.name: originatedBy
relationships.description: Relates a loan to the lending organization that originated it.

relationships.name: securedBy
relationships.description: Relates a secured loan to pledged collateral assets.

relationships.name: repaidBySchedule
relationships.description: Relates a loan to its payment schedule.

relationships.name: servicedBy
relationships.description: Relates a loan to the servicing organization collecting payments.

relationships.name: hasPaymentHistory
relationships.description: Links a payment schedule to payment history records.

relationships.name: hasIndividualPayment
relationships.description: Links a payment history record to each payment transaction event.

relationships.name: classifiesCollateralOwnership
relationships.description: Classifies collateral using ownership interest categories.

relationships.name: hasLienPosition
relationships.description: Classifies collateral by lender claim seniority.
